text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Zephyr (enterprise) streaming failures from their app gateway detected in us-west-2. Severity: high. Symptoms: mid-stream websocket disconnects + client retries causing tenant slot exhaustion on zephyr-dedicated pool. Paging on-call SRE @mike_oncall.

sara_dev: saw the bot — paging now. Any customer-reported errors?

mike_oncall: oncall here. Confirming: increased 502/WS_CLOSE from app gateway, rapid reconnects. Short-lived but high QPS spikes. Putting incident bridge.

ashley_se: Jordan from Zephyr is in the channel (copied). Jordan — what's your side observing?

jordan_zephyr: We get streams cutting after ~15–30s. Client then auto-retries twice, sometimes making the UI rehydrate and fan out requests. Saw many 1006/connection reset codes. Only for some routes behind our proxy.

emma_support: Support ticket #ZEP-512 opened with full logs attached. Customer impact: degraded streaming UX for ~70% sessions in their EU region, falling back to polling for some clients.

raj_sre: quick hypothesis — our gateway is timing out on idle frames while their proxy aggressively reuses connections and drops half-duplex keepalives. Retry loops amplify request concurrency to the dedicated tenant pool, hitting tenant isolation limits.

mike_oncall: agreed. Immediate mitigations we can do: 1) short-term per-tenant websocket concurrency throttle, 2) route Zephyr to their reserved fallback pool with higher connection headroom, 3) add WS keepalive pings on edge.

ashley_se: Jordan can you change your proxy keepalive to send pings every 20s? That might help.

jordan_zephyr: We can push a config change, but it'll take ~30 mins for canary rollout across their fleet. Can you do anything on your side meanwhile?

raj_sre: I'll apply an emergency tenant throttle — reduce concurrent streaming sessions for tenant zephyr by 40%. Command: 
```
rctl patch tenant/zephyr --set streaming_concurrency=0.6
```
Applying now, will monitor.

incident-bot: ACTION — runbook "ws-retry-throttle" invoked by raj_sre. Notifying network team.

nate_neteng: jumping in. Need packet captures from the front-most LB and customer's proxy to confirm FIN/RST source. Emma, can you request tcpdump pcap s for the affected time windows?

emma_support: asked Zephyr to provide pcaps; also pulled edge LB trace. Attaching sample: `edge:us-west-2:lb-12: 2026-03-17T14:02:11Z WS_CLOSE code=1006 bytes=0`

mike_oncall: raj — after throttle, are we seeing slot pressure drop?

raj_sre: initial metrics: connection churn dropped 45% in the next 60s, queue depth on zephyr-dedicated decreased. However, residual retry spikes still persist from long-tail clients. I'm pushing a fallback route now to move new incoming sessions to zephyr-fallback-pool in us-west-2. Command: 
```
redwood-route set --tenant zephyr --pool zephyr-fallback-pool --drain 30s
```

incident-bot: ROUTE CHANGE applied by raj_sre. New sessions should land on fallback pool within 30s.

ashley_se: Jordan — please proceed with your keepalive rollout. Also, if you can disable client auto-retry for streaming endpoints during the rollout, that would reduce amplification.

jordan_zephyr: We'll disable retry in 5 mins, canary to 10% then ramp. Keepalive rollout started.

nate_neteng: I see anomalous half-close patterns from Zephyr's proxy in our pcap — they send RST after a period, seems like an idle timeout on their side. Recommend they increase upstream keepalive and lower proxy idle tear-down.

raj_sre: adding temporary reverse-proxy NGINX tweak to accept longer idle: 
```
proxy_read_timeout 90s;
proxy_send_timeout 90s;
```
Pushing a config flip for the zephyr route now.

emma_support: Noted. I'm updating the support ticket with mitigation steps and telling Zephyr we're throttling/redirecting traffic while they patch.

mike_oncall: handoff: I'm on-call for the next 10m, then handing to @raj_sre for sustained mitigation and postmortem. Raj — please lead the bridge and coordinate with neteng + customer eng.

raj_sre: taking over. Next steps: 1) confirm keepalive rollout success, 2) confirm pcap shows fewer RSTs, 3) keep throttle until customer confirms stable for 45m, then gradual rollback, 4) collect traces for postmortem.

ashley_se: I'll prepare an external status note for Zephyr's SREs and PMs summarizing actions and ETA.

jordan_zephyr: Thanks everyone. We see reduced errors on initial canary (10%). Will report after full rollback.

incident-bot: UPDATE — mitigation in progress. Severity reduced to medium. Next update in 15m or on significant change.

raj_sre: logging: capture included. `grep "WS_CLOSE code=1006" /var/log/edge/ws.log | tail -n 50` shows markedly fewer entries post-throttle. Saving snapshot to /incidents/3899001111/trace-snapshot.log

mike_oncall: thanks team. I'll join the PM sync at +30 to brief.

emma_support: Zephyr confirms full rollout completed, keepalive set to 20s, retries disabled for streaming. Monitoring now.

nate_neteng: final pcap shows RSTs near-zero post-change, looks like the keepalive fixed flakiness.

raj_sre: good. We'll keep throttles in place for 45m then start a controlled rollback while monitoring. I'll create the incident ticket for follow-up and RCA owner.

ashley_se: RCA owner assigned: raj_sre. Action items: runbook updates for tenant-throttle, doc for enterprise proxy keepalive guidance, and a test harness for streaming retry amplification.

jordan_zephyr: Appreciate the fast response. Please send a postmortem and configuration notes we can share with our infra team.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigations stable. Monitoring window started.

raj_sre: closing handoff to post-incident. Will post root cause and timeline in channel when available.

mike_oncall: clear on-call.
